title: Associate General Manager, Project & Engineering
description:
**Role Purpose**

Lead the **engineering and execution of a greenfield biosimilars manufacturing facility** , covering conceptual design, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, qualification, and handover to operations.


The role will have overall engineering ownership for **facility, process systems, utilities, equipment, HVAC, automation, electrical, civil/structural, and infrastructure** , ensuring the project meets approved scope, schedule, CAPEX, GMP, EHS, quality, and regulatory requirements.  



**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Engineering Project Leadership**

* Lead all engineering activities for the greenfield biosimilars facility from **concept design through commissioning and handover** .
* Develop the engineering execution strategy, project organization, deliverables, schedules, and resource requirements.
* Establish and manage engineering **scope, budget, schedule, interfaces, risks, and technical deliverables** .
* Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams and ensure timely resolution of technical issues.
* Lead technical reviews, design reviews, HAZOP/HAZID, constructability reviews, value engineering, and design optimization.

**2\. Facility \& Process Engineering**

* Drive development of **facility layouts, process flows, material/personnel flows, zoning, segregation, and cleanroom concepts** .
* Ensure facility design supports biosimilar manufacturing requirements, including:
	+ Upstream processing
	+ Downstream processing
	+ Buffer/media preparation
	+ Formulation
	+ Drug substance/drug product areas, as applicable
	+ Sampling and dispensing
	+ Cold rooms/freezers
	+ Warehousing
	+ QC laboratories
* Review and approve **URS, FRS, process descriptions, PFDs, P\&IDs, equipment specifications, and engineering drawings** .
* Ensure design incorporates appropriate future expansion and capacity requirements.

**3\. Utilities \& Infrastructure**

Provide engineering oversight for critical GMP and non\-GMP utilities, including:


* Purified Water / WFI systems
* Clean steam
* Process gases and compressed air
* HVAC and cleanroom systems
* Chilled water and cooling systems
* Boilers and hot\-water systems
* Nitrogen and other specialty gases
* Electrical distribution and backup power
* Building management systems
* Effluent and waste\-treatment systems
* Fire protection systems
* Plant and site infrastructure

**4\. Equipment Engineering \& Procurement**

* Lead selection, specification, technical evaluation, and procurement of major process and utility equipment.
* Review vendor proposals and participate in **technical bid evaluations** .
* Manage equipment design reviews, **FAT/SAT** , vendor documentation, and installation requirements.
* Ensure equipment selection meets GMP, maintainability, safety, reliability, and lifecycle\-cost requirements.
* Coordinate integration of **single\-use and stainless\-steel technologies** , as applicable.

**5\. EPC / EPCM \& Contractor Management**

* Manage EPC/EPCM consultants, engineering contractors, construction contractors, and equipment vendors.
* Review engineering deliverables and ensure compliance with approved design standards.
* Monitor contractor performance against **scope, schedule, quality, and cost** .
* Lead technical and commercial discussions related to engineering changes and contractor claims.
* Ensure effective interface management between engineering disciplines and construction teams.

**6\. Automation \& Digital Systems**

* Provide engineering leadership for **BMS, EMS, SCADA, DCS/PLC, process automation, and facility monitoring systems** .
* Ensure appropriate integration between process equipment and site automation systems.
* Coordinate with IT/CSV teams for computerized\-system requirements and GMP compliance.
* Support implementation of data\-integrity and electronic\-record requirements.

**7\. Construction, Commissioning \& Qualification**

* Provide engineering leadership throughout construction and installation.
* Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, GMP requirements, and EHS standards.
* Lead construction punch\-list closure and technical issue resolution.
* Coordinate **commissioning, qualification, and validation** activities with CQV, QA, Engineering, and Operations.
* Ensure readiness of systems for **IQ/OQ/PQ and process qualification** , as applicable.
* Drive engineering handover and preparation of final documentation/as\-built drawings.

**8\. GMP \& Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure engineering design complies with applicable **cGMP, GEP, GxP, EHS, and regulatory requirements** .
* Incorporate relevant requirements from **US FDA, EMA, MHRA, WHO, PIC/S, ISPE, and applicable local regulations** .
* Participate in regulatory inspection preparation and provide engineering support during inspections.
* Ensure appropriate engineering documentation, traceability, change control, and deviation management.

**9\. Project Controls \& Governance**

* Develop and maintain the **engineering master schedule** and critical\-path activities.
* Track engineering progress, procurement milestones, construction progress, and commissioning readiness.
* Manage engineering CAPEX and identify cost\-saving/value\-engineering opportunities.
* Establish project KPIs and provide regular reporting to senior management.
* Proactively identify and mitigate technical and execution risks.

  
**Education:** B.E/ B. Tech (Mechanical/ Electrical/ Electronics/ Instrumentation)

title: Rotating Equipment Project Engineer (Project Lead Engineer)
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
--------------------------


Are you ready to take your engineering career to the next level with Siemens Energy? As a Project Lead Engineer(Rotating Engineer), you will have the outstanding opportunity to work on groundbreaking projects that craft the future of energy. This role is located in India, where you will collaborate with our extraordinary team to deliver outstanding solutions!

**How You’ll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* Responsibility for this position: coordinate yourself the technical execution of a few assigned client orders ; striving for execution excellence
* Align with the applicable Project Management Process in place, as well as apply the Company standards regarding Quality and EHS management.
* Use global collaborative tools (SharePoint, Jira, Globus) recommended by COE management for efficient team project management.
* Follow a project leadership approach and not just a catalogue of design recipes: rather than select right away “the best technical solution” when facing critical decisions, compile and submit to the PM scenarii or alternatives that compare as required.
* Technical risk assessment, execution risk for Company, Client benefit, possible impact on project spend \& critical path.
* Depend on, and generally follow the design authority held by the relevant engineering team managers or lead engineers (e.g. Core Compressor, Systems, Controls, Package integration), or with the concerned area expert (e.g. rotor dynamics, metallurgy).
* In case of technical recommendations conflicting with each other, evaluate, decide and communicate on the way forward. If important metrics are at risk, recommend a solution to the project manager and Center of Excellence for resolution.
* Upon request of his manager, coach one or a few less experienced REPE(s) through the challenges of their assigned jobs.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* BE/B.Tech in mechanical engineering or – other degrees in systems, chemical or fluid dynamics engineering with rotating machinery experience.
* **Upto 5 years of experience** with industrial equipment, services or projects, among which ideally 2 years responsibilities in relation with rotating equipment for O\&G industry in one or several of these functions: product or system engineering, design development, machine testing, installation, commissioning, operation, repair, upgrade.
* Familiar with the functional principles and the associated auxiliary systems (centrifugal compressor; reciprocating compressor; aeroderivative or industrial\-type gas turbine; condensation or back\-pressure steam turbine; electric machinery)
* **Detailed knowledge of** system instrumentation and wiring methods, compressor process design, control, and/or dynamic simulation; piping and valving; package layout.
* Application of materials, welding, and coating systems; rotor dynamics; aero\-thermodynamic performance calculation; specification of couplings and gearboxes; vibration analysis
* Machinery trouble\-shooting; any industry standard relevant for O\&G markets (count 1 for each individual standard in libraries like: API, ASME, EU Directives, IEC, CSA, NORSOK, NR, etc..)
* Curious of products and technologies, keen on learning on the fly.
* **Proven analytical and communication skills** when processing or delivering written and verbal information

**About the Team**
------------------


Our **Transformation of Industry** division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**


At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.


Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.


Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo


**Our Commitment to Diversity**
-------------------------------


Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits**
--------------------

* All employees are automatically covered under the Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy.As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay on a monthly basis.

**https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs**

description:
**About the Role:**

Silent Infotech is looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation, delivery, transformation, upgrade, migration, integration, and go\-live programs for international customers. The role requires strong ownership of scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, stakeholder communication, and cross\-functional coordination across functional consultants, developers, QA, DevOps, support teams, and customer stakeholders. Hands\-on experience delivering ERP projects is mandatory. Experience with Odoo ERP is an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of ERP implementation projects from discovery and planning through configuration, development, integration, data migration, UAT, go\-live, hypercare, and handover.
* Manage ERP transformation programs involving process redesign, legacy\-system replacement, phased rollouts, upgrades, migrations, and multi\-module implementations.
* Translate customer business requirements into structured project scope, milestones, work breakdown structures, delivery plans, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate functional consultants, technical teams, developers, QA, DevOps, integration teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure aligned and timely delivery.
* Manage project scope, timelines, resource allocation, budgets/effort, dependencies, change requests, risks, issues, and escalations.
* Lead customer meetings including project kick\-offs, requirement reviews, steering/status meetings, UAT reviews, go\-live readiness, and post\-go\-live support reviews.
* Ensure strong governance through project plans, RAID logs, action trackers, status reports, meeting minutes, documentation, and delivery dashboards.
* Drive fit\-gap analysis and ensure clear decisions between standard ERP functionality, configuration, customization, integration, and process change.
* Manage third\-party integrations, APIs, middleware dependencies, data migration activities, and coordination with external vendors where applicable.
* Plan and govern SIT/UAT cycles, defect resolution, cutover planning, go\-live checklists, rollback/contingency planning, and production readiness.
* Provide live customer interaction and leadership during critical go\-live, hypercare, production support, and escalation situations.
* Identify delivery risks early, establish mitigation plans, remove blockers, and escalate decisions to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Ensure projects meet agreed quality standards, contractual commitments, customer expectations, and internal delivery processes.
* Support presales and solution teams when required with project estimation, implementation approach, delivery timelines, resource planning, and proposal/RFP inputs.
* Mentor project coordinators and team members and contribute to continuous improvement of ERP delivery practices.

**Experience Requirements:**

* Minimum 7\+ years of overall professional experience in IT/ERP project delivery, with demonstrable responsibility for ERP implementation projects.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Strong ERP project/program management experience across proprietary and/or open\-source ERP platforms.
* Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, Odoo, ERPNext, or comparable enterprise systems.
* Ability to understand both functional business processes and technical delivery dependencies including integrations, APIs, data migration, environments, and deployments.
* Strong stakeholder management, customer communication, negotiation, conflict resolution, and escalation\-handling skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, dependencies, and teams while maintaining delivery visibility and accountability.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills, including project plans, RAID logs, status reports, effort tracking, action registers, and executive updates.
* Hands\-on experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Odoo Project, MS Project, or equivalent is a plus
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Business, Management, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to Have:**

* Valid US Business(B1/B2\) visa.
* Prior onsite travel history for customer meetings, discovery, implementation, training, or go\-live activities.
* Experience interacting directly with US, European, Middle East, or other international customers.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, SAFe, ITIL, or ERP\-vendor certifications.
* Experience in manufacturing, distribution, retail, services, accounting, CRM, supply chain, or other ERP\-intensive business domains.
* Willingness to travel onsite internationally based on project requirements.

* On\-time and within\-scope ERP project delivery.
* Budget/effort variance and resource utilization.
* Milestone achievement and schedule adherence.
* Risk, issue, dependency, and change\-request closure effectiveness.
* UAT readiness, defect closure, and go\-live success.
* Customer satisfaction and stakeholder communication quality.
* Post\-go\-live stabilization and reduction of critical escalations.
* Project documentation, governance, and reporting quality.
* Must have independently managed or played a lead delivery role in multiple end\-to\-end ERP implementations, including at least one production go\-live.

description:
**Project Manager – Wellness Resorts \& Partnerships**

We are looking for a Project Manager to work closely with the senior leadership team, and external partners on wellness resort growth, new venture evaluation, and strategic partnerships.

This role is not limited to tracking tasks. The person will be expected to keep leadership informed, move decisions forward, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and ensure that agreed actions are completed on time.

**Role Purpose**

The Project Manager will act as the central coordination point for a portfolio of wellness resort and partnership initiatives. This includes supporting existing resort operations, assessing potential wellness retreat opportunities in India and overseas, engaging hospitality and technology partners, and maintaining an active network of wellness experts.

The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly with senior executives, business owners, consultants, and potential partners. They should be structured, commercially aware, and able to handle multiple workstreams without losing follow\-through.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary coordination link between the senior leadership team, internal teams, and external stakeholders.
* Prepare regular updates for the leadership team on priorities, decisions required, progress against plans, risks, and next actions.
* Manage project plans, timelines, meeting cadence, action trackers, and stakeholder communications across multiple initiatives.
* Support the growth and improvement of existing wellness resort businesses.
* Evaluate potential wellness retreat, resort, land, property, and business acquisition opportunities in India and, where relevant, international markets.
* Conduct preliminary research on potential locations, including market demand, accessibility, local competition, tourism trends, regulatory considerations, operating feasibility, and partner availability.
* Coordinate discussions with property owners, sellers, operators, hospitality companies, consultants, and potential collaborators.
* Support commercial discussions and negotiations with sellers, business owners, hospitality partners, and technology providers.
* Track leadership assignments and ensure that owners, deadlines, dependencies, and outcomes are clearly documented.
* Build and maintain relationships with wellness experts in India and the United States, including clinicians, therapists, retreat designers, nutrition specialists, fitness professionals, and wellness program advisors.
* Identify technology companies that can support wellness operations, guest experience, bookings, CRM, diagnostics, preventive health, digital engagement, or operational reporting.
* Coordinate partnership discussions and help prepare proposals, commercial summaries, meeting notes, and draft agreements.
* Escalate delays, decision gaps, and project risks early, with practical options for resolution.

**Key Deliverables**

**Weekly leadership status report**

Concise update covering project status, key achievements, upcoming milestones, decisions required, risks, and action owners

**Project plans**

Detailed plans for each initiative, including scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies, responsibilities, and risk mitigation actions

**Opportunity assessment reports**

Location and business evaluation reports for prospective resorts, retreats, properties, or partnerships

**Stakeholder communication log**

Record of meetings, discussions, commitments, follow\-up actions, and relationship status with partners and experts

**Partnership proposals**

Structured proposals for hospitality, wellness, and technology partners, including commercial rationale and next steps

**Expert network database**

Curated list of wellness experts, their areas of expertise, contact details, past interactions, and potential contribution to current projects

**Leadership action tracker**

Central tracker for Chairman and senior\-management assignments, with ownership, deadlines, progress, and closure status

**Required Experience and Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in project management, business development, strategy, hospitality, wellness, real estate, consulting, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with senior executives and manage confidential or high\-priority assignments.
* Experience coordinating external stakeholders, including business owners, consultants, vendors, operators, and strategic partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear executive updates and meeting summaries.
* Good commercial judgment and confidence in supporting negotiations and partnership discussions.
* Ability to assess business opportunities using structured criteria rather than relying only on informal discussions.
* Strong follow\-through, attention to detail, and discipline in managing action items.
* Ability to manage several active initiatives at the same time while maintaining clear priorities.
* Proficiency with project\-management and productivity tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, Notion, Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with the Indian wellness, hospitality, tourism, healthcare, preventive health, or retreat market will be an advantage.
* International exposure or experience working with stakeholders in the United States, Middle East, Europe, or Southeast Asia would be useful.

**Preferred Profile**

The ideal candidate will be practical, organized, and commercially minded. They should be able to move comfortably between a executive\-level briefing, a discussion with a resort operator, a call with a wellness expert, and follow\-up with a technology vendor.

They must know how to turn discussions into clear next steps. For example, after an initial conversation with a resort owner, the Project Manager should document the opportunity, identify missing information, arrange due diligence inputs, track commercial assumptions, and prepare a short decision note for leadership.

This role will suit someone who enjoys building order around complex, evolving initiatives and is willing to take ownership of follow\-up rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
